chapter_title: [Concerning the Five] War[s that the] Sons of [Li]
spiritual_reading:
# The Five
 Spiritual
 Comb
ats —
 Translated into
 the
 Spiritual Sense

---


**
¶2 
—
 The First Combat
**


The first
 spiritual
 combat is that of the celest
ial principle
 of the Divine
 Human
, which it
 waged against the ruling
 falsity that
 gov
erns the corru
pted sens
ory planes of the
 mind
,
 and against
 all the derivative
 ev
ils that had
 proceeded
 from the five external
 degrees
 of sensation
 given
 over
 to fals
ity. The celest
ial principle pursued
 these
 evils by
 means
 of the
 living
 truth arranged
 in
 order
 —
 which
 is wisdom
 itself
 made
 active
.
 It laid
 its
 arrangement
 so
 that the pure
 love of truth,
 unt
ou
ched and
 unc
orrupted,
 exposed
 them
,
 and they
 found
 no way to escape the
 ordering
 power
 of truth
. They
 were seized
 as
 natural
 falsities are
 seized —
 as
 things
 of
 the lowest
 knowing
 caught
 in the net of a
 higher
 light
.
 The five
 interior
 counsel
s belonging
 to the five external planes
 of perception
 were thus
 laid
 open
.
 And
 the deep
est root of the five perv
erted perceptions —
 the in
most origin
 of every
 false
 app
rehension of
 reality
 — was sev
ered and
 torn
 out,
 as
 the
 sharp
 power of divine
 truth cuts like
 an axe at
 the hidden
 root of an
 evil tree.

---


**¶3 — The
 Second Combat**

The second spiritual combat
 is that of the divine
 spiritual principle which
 orders and
 arran
ges all things. This
 principle established
 the interior
 structures
 and
 the heavenly degrees
 of order
;
 it extended
 the evil
 persu
asions into
 fixed
 positions
 and
 bound
 them within
 limits
 in
 the middle
 regions of the mind.
 Kn
owledges of
 truth were set
 in their
 proper
 places
 within
 the understanding
,
 and the natural
 planes
 of thought
 were arranged,
 and all
 things
 were disposed
 into
 the three containing degrees of the mind —
 the celestial, the spiritual, and
 the natural. For
 the dominant
 ev
ils resisted and
 set
 themselves
 against the ordering
 spiritual
 principle. They sought
 to overth
row it,
 because
 they perceived
 and
 recognized
 that it had
 power
 to
 bind and fetter them with
 an
 un
breakable restra
int of
 divine
 order. Yet the divine spiritual principle presented
 itself in
 many forms of
 power
, with inn
umerable capac
ities,
 with manif
old operations
 and with
 an
 overwhelming
 force
 that
 could not be with
stood. It revealed
 itself to them and
 imprisoned them with consum
mate wisdom
. Not
 one fals
ity or
 evil was able to deliver
 itself, and all
 were
 held
 fast
.
 Because
 this
 ordering
 principle
 possessed
 the full
ness
 of divine
 power, it en
snared every
 resistant
 evil
 without
 exception.


---

**¶4 
— The Third Combat**

The third
 spiritual combat is that of divine
 truth made
 openly
 manifest
,
 which displayed
 the
 visible
 form of wisdom
 to
 all
 that
 lies
 beneath
 it in
 the lower
 planes
 of the mind. It
 drew
 forth
 and
 separated all
 wisdom
 and every
 good
 possession
 from
 the things
 that had
 consumed
 and
 absorbed
 them
. The entire
 domin
ion of self-love —
 with
 all its assumed
 glory
,
 which
 was
 stolen
 rad
iance
 —
 was exposed
 by
 the
 extending
 of this
 manif
ested
 truth
. Then
 a power
 comes
 from
 within
, which is mighty
:
 it strips
 from
 self
-
love all its
 accumulated
 kn
owledges,
 its
 tru
ths perv
erted to
 its own use
, its
 ar
rogant
 display
 and
 its ind
ulgence in
 its
 own appet
ites.


---

**¶5 
— The
 Pur
ification**

This
 is the
 nature
 of the domin
ion of self-love: it poss
esses all spiritual
 ri
ches as
 though
 they were its own, carrying
 them through
 the planes
 of the mind as
 though they belonged
 to it.
 But
 the
 manif
ested divine
 truth cle
ansed and purified wisdom
 from every
 adm
ixture of falsity and
 self
-derived
 claiming
.


---

**¶6 
— The Fourth Combat**

The fourth
 spiritual combat is that which
 Divine
 Wisdom itself
 —
 in
 its
 full
ness
 of
 glory
 — w
aged against all the rebell
ious evils that had risen
 up
 in both
 the interior and the
 exterior degrees
 of the mind. When wisdom had
 been partially
 separated from
 them
 by
 the manifest
 form of divine
 truth, their restra
ints were loosened, and they
 broke forth
 again in
 a new uprising
 of
 the entire domin
ion of self-love. Divine
 Wisdom then
 gir
ded itself
 with
 the
 whole
 armor
 of truth a
 second time.
 It re
-established the entire structure
 of order
 within
 the mind and
 entered
 into the
 supreme
 tem
ptation-
combat,
 and
 ther
ein every
 evil was hum
bled
 and
 brought
 low. In
 this way
 it fulfilled the purpose
 of the Divine
 itself
.
 It gave the promise
 of regeneration to the earliest and
 in
most human
 will, and it carried
 that
 will
 toward
 the
 doc
trinal vessel
 that bears
 wisdom safely
 through
 the world
.

---

**¶7
 — The Fifth Combat**

The
 fifth spiritual combat is that of
 the inmost divine purpose of
 life itself
 —
 which is the calling-
forth of truth and the willing reception of
 it
 in
 ob
edience —
 the
 union
 of the
 call
 from
 above
 with
 the response from
 below.
 This
 in
most purpose descended
 upon all
 the planes
 of the mind and upon
 everything
 within
 them
,
 even
 upon
 the state
 of spiritual
 death that
 had
 ruled
 there
. And it was victorious over spiritual
 death forever
, and it best
owed the heav
enly kingdom —
 the full
 dominion of love
 and
 wisdom
 united
 —
 upon the regenerated human
 being
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The second war is that of the Living Spirit [, who came forth to order all things]. He has constructed the things and the worlds of light; he spread out the rulers and chained them in the middle [of the heavens; he set] the stars in [the firmaments; he formed] the earths [and gathered] them in the three vessels. For the rulers rebelled and were set against the Living Spirit. They wished to [overthrow him,] since they knew and realised that he might bind and fetter them with a strong chain. Yet he, the Living Spirit, (appeared to them) with many aspects, with numerous [powers], with many hands and great cruelties. He was revealed to them, he imprisoned them with much skill. Not one of them was able to save (himself), and he {[overcame them]} [all]. Now, since he [possessed the fullness of power,] he trapped them [all, and none] [escaped].

The fifth war is this that the counsel of life [has waged,] which is the summons and the obedience [, the] great [union of the calling and the hearing;] and it placed [its dominion] upon the [worlds] and the [realms therein] [, even upon the kingdom] of death, which [contended] with it. And it was victorious over [death] for ever, and it gave the kingdom [to the children of the light].

The first war is that of the First living Man, which he waged against the King of the realms of Darkness, and all the rulers that had come forth from the five worlds of [...]. He hunted them with his net, which is the living soul. He [...] in the snare and [...] the face of the [...] his virgin, the living fire [...] they did not find how to escape his net [...] he caught them like fish [...] the five counsels of the five elements [...]. He cut and dug out the root of the five trees, [...] root of the evil tree, like an axe.

The third war is that of the Third Ambassador who has displayed his image [...] what is below [...] scooped [...] all light and the property [...] the ones that are consumed [...] the entire ruling-power [...] pride of the light [...] extending it [...]. A person comes, who is powerful [...]; he takes his riches [...], silver [...], his pride and wantonness.
This is what the ruling-power is like [...], all riches [...] as they travel [...] light [...]. He cleansed and purified it.

The fourth war is this that Jesus the glorious one waged against all the rebels who had rebelled above and below. When the light was purified from them by the image of the Third Ambassador, their chains loosened [...]. The glorious one in the fourth war; he came and brought [...] a rebellion of the entire ruling-power. He girded himself [...] all of it another time. He constructed the whole structure and he made [...] a great contest; he humiliated therein. [...] he fulfilled the will of the greatness, [he gave the] hope to Adam [...] to his light ship.
